<!-- Add it back / exclude it / adjust its configuration — what exactly should change? -->

## Intention

<!-- What outcome are you after? E.g. "modules with X should not be penalised",

## Reasoning

<!-- Why is the change justified? Concrete examples help a lot:

## Impact
